subject: SOC 2 evidence request — onboarding training records + deprovisioning timeline
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <acme_security@acme.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com
Cc: audits@bluecrest.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 request — onboarding/offboarding controls evidence

Hi Rachel,

We're preparing the SOC 2 vendor assessment for Q4 and need to collect evidence around employee lifecycle controls at Redwood Inference for Acme's procurement team. Please provide the following artifacts (or a mutually agreed delivery plan):

- Current training completion roster for security awareness and secure coding (most recent quarter)
- Summary of pre-hire background checks (redacted as needed) and the vendor used
- Onboarding checklist showing access provisioning steps (examples or SOP)
- Offboarding/deprovisioning logs showing account revocations and timing for departures over the last 90 days
- Any attestation or attestation log that new hires complete (policy acceptance)

Can you confirm owners and an ETA? Ideally we'd like everything in a shareable folder by EOD Thu (2026-09-17).

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Security Procurement — Acme Corp
acme_security@acme.com

[Note: please send sensitive docs as redacted PDFs. We can sign an NDA if needed.]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com

Monica / Marcus — looping you both in to own pieces of this request from Acme (cc'd auditor Bluecrest).

Quick plan: I've drafted a folder and a short evidence plan (attached) that maps each bullet from Acme to the artifact type we can provide. Target: consolidated folder by Thu EOD (2026-09-17).

Action items:
- Monica: please pull the training roster for Q3 2026 and the pre-hire background check summary (redacted). Note: Acme asked for vendor name — include that and a short description of redaction approach.
- Marcus: provide the access revocation/deprovisioning log for the last 90 days plus the onboarding provisioning checklist or a copy of the SOP.
- Maya: flag any privacy concerns for redaction and confirm retention timelines.
- Sean: hold the drive folder with restricted share and notify me when done so I can send to Acme.

Attachments: evidence_request_plan.md (maps items to files + who/where).

If any part cannot be completed by Thu, propose the earliest date for partial delivery. I will be the contact for Acme.

Thanks — R

Rachel Kim
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com
